history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: the temple is near Dhanwar/Rajdhanwar, not Giridih town - documented with the corrected town. Jharkhand Dham (Jharkhandi) is an ancient Shiva temple and significant pilgrimage centre about 55 km from Giridih and ~10 km from Rajdhanwar. Its exact construction date is unknown (per velpu.com). A unique feature is that the temple buildings are roofless. A pond stands in front of the temple and the Irga river crosses to its southwest. In 1967 the Sanskrit Hindi Vidyapith was established at Jharkhand Dham, affiliated with Vinoba Bhave University. Devotees crowd the temple on Maha Shivaratri.

name: Jharkhandi Dham
town: Dhanwar (CSV town 'Giridih' is WRONG - the temple is near Dhanwar/Rajdhanwar, ~55 km from Giridih town)
town_description: Dhanwar (Rajdhanwar) is a town in Giridih district, Jharkhand. The Jharkhand Dham temple lies off the Rajdhanwar-Jharkhandi road, about 10-13 km from Rajdhanwar and roughly 55 km from the Giridih district headquarters. A pond stands in front of the temple and the Irga river crosses to its southwest, giving the complex a distinctive waterside setting.
